Self-hosted web fonts for the Editions covers. All are SIL Open Font License 1.1
(https://openfontlicense.org). The page's UI face, which the covers also use as NJ Text (fronts at
800/900, back labels at 400/600), is documented in ui/SOURCE.txt.

Each file below is a Google Fonts text= subset of one static instance: it holds exactly the glyphs the
covers draw in that face, no more. All were downloaded 2026-11-03 from fonts.gstatic.com through the
css2 request shown (text= value URL-encoded). The back faces' sets come from the strings in the tracked
editions/data/projects.json.

Regenerating: when a title, a back-cover name or figure, a stack line or the About headline changes,
recompute the face's glyph set from editions/data/projects.json (sorted unique characters of the
strings listed for it), request css2?family=<axes as shown>&text=<set>, take the single url(...) in the
response, and replace the file. A character outside its face's set renders in a fallback font.

poppins-extrabold-cover.woff2 — NJ Poppins, the Social Hook title
  Poppins (Indian Type Foundry), gstatic v24, wght 800
  glyphs: " HSaciklo" (from "Social Hook")

  Licence: OFL-1.1 (https://github.com/itfoundry/Poppins)

archivo-narrow-700-cover.woff2 — NJ Narrow, the stet title (each letter placed on its concept letter)
  Archivo Narrow (Omnibus-Type), gstatic v35, wght 700
  glyphs: "est" (from "stet")
  css2?family=Archivo+Narrow:wght@700&text=est
  992 bytes, sha256 cd4ba9c3c2bd42ef30ffa309f826b0432ecbbe0f29384f107be7db4bfabcdf23
  Licence: OFL-1.1 (https://github.com/Omnibus-Type/ArchivoNarrow). Chosen by fitting 45 OFL candidates
  (Inter, Archivo at several widths and weights, Archivo Black, Libre Franklin, Barlow, Roboto Condensed and
  others) to the concept's letter masks; it fit best (IoU 0.87, every letter box within 1.1% of the cover).

  css2?family=Hanken%20Grotesk:wght@600&text=ehinopst

  in ~/dev/topshine-design-waitlist/engine/assets/fonts/. Chosen by fitting 57 OFL candidates (Hanken Grotesk at
  600 to 800, Red Hat Display, Manrope, Plus Jakarta Sans, Inter, Figtree and others) to the concept's letter masks;

The fronts load the first eight with the UI face; the last two load with the first back.
